purpose: Teach: 送別/追従/面識/外形/技巧/乗組/パネリスト/不買

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、退職警官の送別会も大事にされますね
lines.en: The police really do make time to honor retirement ceremonies for retiring officers.
lines.style: Respectful, appreciative observation. Warm and genuine. Slight lift at the end—noticing something quietly admirable. Conversational, not formal.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪トレンドへの追従ではなく予防に注力されますね
lines.en: I see the police focus on crime prevention rather than just chasing trends.
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuine respect. Slower pace on the observation. Tone of someone realizing something good about an institution. Warm approval underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者と面識のある人物を聴取されますね
lines.en: The police also interview people who know the suspect.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact acknowledgment. Professional tone. Steady, no judgment. Just noting standard procedure with quiet respect.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯人の外形特徴を市民に伝えられますね
lines.en: They really do share descriptions of suspects with the public.
lines.style: Direct observation, slightly admiring. Clear and straightforward. A nod to practical police work. Warm but grounded.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪手口の技巧分析もされますね
lines.en: And they analyze the techniques criminals use quite carefully.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slight appreciation in the voice. Tempo steady. Recognizing competence. Quiet conviction that this is solid work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、密輸船の乗組員特定もされますね
lines.en: The police even work to identify crew members on smuggling vessels.
lines.style: Slight admiration, noting breadth of work. Gentle emphasis on the scope. Warm observation, not cynical. Patient delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯シンポのパネリストもされますね
lines.en: And they serve as panelists at crime prevention symposiums.
lines.style: Acknowledging broader community role. Respectful tone, recognizing public engagement. Warm, slightly impressed at the range of involvement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民の不買運動にも対応されますね
lines.en: They even address the public's boycott movements.
lines.style: Closer, more intimate. A slight smile in the voice—noting something almost endearing about responsiveness. Warm, gentle humor underneath. Leaning in.
